_comment: HAND-AUTHORED SOURCE — the claim-level evidence register (EVREG-1). One entry per registered public claim that already carries a COUNT sentinel on a shipped surface; anchors only, never a copy rewrite. Generator (single writer): node scripts/gen-evidence-register.mjs emits evidence/claims.json + source/<id>.txt. Gate: node scripts/check-evidence-register.mjs. review_by is a hard commitment: past-due claims red the register gate on main (reviews only move forward; a deliberate re-pin via --update-baseline). All paths repo-anchored.

claims.claim: Homepage 'Live MCP Tools' hero stat (count sentinel mcp.live: the servedNodes + pilot + EXPECTED_UTIL figure the counts engine derives).
claims.scope: Public homepage stat. Value is derived by the counts engine (scripts/verify-counts.mjs) and may be rewritten main-side by its --fix; a moved value is a drift event that re-opens this claim for review. Re-validated 2026-09-22 after the 719->720 counts regen landed on main during this row's rebase.
